name: The Lived Evolution Clause
tagline: A girl who changes is not a girl who was recorded wrong.
body: When a girl's build expression, Pillar, body, status or dynamic shifts, the shift is filed as a canon change with an effective arc — the prior state is preserved as Historical rather than deleted. This is the clause the whole Archive is built to serve: Abbi at 9.8 inches in an early arc and 10.8 later are both true, because canon has a date. A profile records Former Expression and a one-sentence Lived Evolution naming what shifted and the arc-level cause.
rules: Every change carries an effective arc
The superseded value is kept, marked Historical, and shown struck through beneath the current one
Current · Historical · Draft · Proposed · Disputed · Retired are six different things, and the Archive keeps them apart
A Proposed change is something you and I discussed and never adopted — it is not canon and never resolves into the current view
